part.name: Cross-arm pivot and clamp assembly
part.description: Three-solid mechanical assembly comprising two intersecting elongated cross-arm components and a central two-sided clamp/pivot component. The arms occupy the CAD X-Z plane and are retained around a common CAD Y-axis pivot. Exact application is uncertain; the geometry is consistent with a folding or pivoting support-frame mechanism.
part.symmetry_note: The assembly is approximately centered at CAD x=0 and z=0. SOLID 1 has a strong paired structure about z=0, while SOLID 2 has opposing clamp plates along the CAD Y direction and rounded-square fourfold geometry in the X-Z plane. The two arm solids intersect near a common Y-axis pivot but have different in-plane orientations and end details.

semantic_orientation.description: No application-specific front, top, or right side is reliably identifiable. CAD Y is the pivot-axis and clamp-thickness direction, while the elongated arms lie predominantly in the CAD X-Z plane. Camera labels are therefore retained only as view references.
